description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - elder day: a six-item all-day gaze checklist for an elder living alone (morning medicine, water, lunch, afternoon medicine, evening walk, doors and windows), each item bound to the head heading of a household object and a family-preset time; look at the object steadily for 2 seconds to confirm, due items are announced once while the agent is open; no permissions, no camera, no dictation, no medical advice
name: elder-day
